jica_manual_ref: Inspired by JICA SHEP PLUS — Cabbage production manual

varieties.name: Gloria F1
varieties.supplier_notes: Most popular hybrid in Central + Rift; uniform 2-3kg heads.

varieties.name: Pruktor F1
varieties.supplier_notes: Holds in field 3+ weeks past maturity without splitting.

timeline_template.description_en: Sow seed in raised nursery at 1cm depth, 5cm apart in rows 15cm.
timeline_template.description_sw: Panda mbegu kitalu chenye kuinuka kina 1cm, umbali wa 5cm na safu 15cm.

timeline_template.description_en: Reduce watering and expose to sun 5 days before transplant.
timeline_template.description_sw: Punguza maji na peleka jua siku 5 kabla ya kupandikiza.
Pandikiza miche wiki 5 nafasi ya 60cm x 45cm.

timeline_template.description_en: Apply 100kg DAP at planting (split into holes).
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka kilo 100 za DAP wakati wa kupanda.

timeline_template.description_en: Scout every 3-4 days for diamondback moth and black rot after wet spells. Early scouting is the entire defence.
timeline_template.description_sw: Chunguza kila siku 3-4 nondo wa kabichi na uoza mweusi baada ya mvua. Kuchunguza mapema ndio ulinzi wote.

timeline_template.description_en: Hand-weed and earth up around base for stability.
timeline_template.description_sw: Palia kwa mkono na rundisha udongo karibu na mmea.

timeline_template.description_en: Spray for diamondback moth + aphids if scout threshold exceeded.
timeline_template.description_sw: Nyunyuza dawa ya wadudu ikiwa wamezidi.

timeline_template.description_en: Second 50kg CAN dose at head-formation stage.
timeline_template.description_sw: Dosi ya pili ya CAN kilo 50 wakati kichwa kinaanza.

timeline_template.description_en: Cut heads at the base with sharp knife when firm and 2kg+.
timeline_template.description_sw: Kata vichwa chini kwa kisu mkali vikishuka 2kg+.
timeline_template.tip_en: Harvest in cool morning hours to extend shelf life.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Vuna asubuhi mapema kuongeza muda wa kuhifadhi.

post_harvest.grading_criteria: Grade A: 2kg+, tight head, no insect damage. Grade B: 1.2-2kg or minor damage.
post_harvest.packaging_standard: Stacked loose in pickup; large heads in 50kg hessian sacks.
post_harvest.storage_tips_en: Cool dark storage 0-4°C holds 3+ months. At room temp, sell within 2 weeks.
post_harvest.storage_tips_sw: Hifadhi 0-4°C miezi 3+. Joto la kawaida — uza ndani ya wiki 2.

diseases.symptoms_en: Caterpillars window the leaves and burrow into young heads.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Viwavi wanatoboa majani na kuingia vichwa vichanga.
diseases.treatment_en: Spray registered larvicides only at threshold; ROTATE chemical classes — DBM builds resistance fast. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Nyunyuza dawa iliyoidhinishwa tu wakati wamezidi; BADILISHA aina za dawa — DBM huzoea haraka. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Scout week 4-12; row covers in the nursery.
diseases.prevention_sw: Chunguza wiki 4-12; funika kitalu kwa wavu.
diseases.scanner_notes: Photo the leaf underside + inside a young head; frass separates DBM from aphids.

diseases.symptoms_en: Colonies curl and stunt the head-forming leaves; honeydew on leaves.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Makundi yanakunja na kudhoofisha majani ya kichwa; utomvu unanata majani.
diseases.treatment_en: Natural enemies often control them early — check before spraying; registered products only if spreading. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Maadui wa asili mara nyingi huwadhibiti mapema — angalia kabla ya dawa; nyunyuza tu ikiwa wanaenea. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_sw: Epuka dawa mapema; chunguza kila wiki.
diseases.scanner_notes: Underside photo with the colony visible.

diseases.symptoms_en: Yellow V-shaped lesions at leaf margins, blackened veins; spreads in wet spells.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa ya manjano yenye umbo la V kwenye kingo, mishipa meusi; husambaa mvua nyingi.
diseases.treatment_en: No cure — remove plants; copper-class products suppress spread. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba — ng'oa mimea; dawa za copper zinazuia kuenea tu. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: 2-3 year brassica rotation, clean seed, no overhead irrigation.
diseases.prevention_sw: Zungusha mashamba miaka 2-3, mbegu safi, usimwagilie kutoka juu.

diseases.symptoms_en: Yellow specks above, grey-purple fuzz below, cool damp spells.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa ya manjano juu, ukungu wa kijivu chini, wakati wa baridi na unyevu.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered downy-active fungicide at first specks. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa iliyoidhinishwa ya ukungu mara madoa yanapoanza. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_sw: Nafasi ya kutosha na hewa; mwagilia asubuhi.
diseases.scanner_notes: Photograph the UNDERSIDE — the fuzz is invisible from above.

diseases.symptoms_en: Water-soaked heads that collapse in the field, foul smell; follows insect damage.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Vichwa vinalowana na kuoza shambani, harufu mbaya; hufuata uharibifu wa wadudu.
diseases.treatment_en: No cure — remove and destroy; manage the insect damage that opens the door. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba — ng'oa na uteketeze; dhibiti wadudu wanaofungua mlango. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: DBM/aphid management, drainage, dry harvest handling.
diseases.prevention_sw: Dhibiti DBM na vidukari, mifereji ya maji, shika kwa usafi wakati wa kuvuna.
diseases.scanner_notes: Ask about insect damage in-app — rot follows damage.

diseases.symptoms_en: One-sided yellowing of lower leaves, brown vascular discoloration in the stem, stunting.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Kuning'inia kwa upande mmoja wa majani ya chini, rangi ya kahawia ndani ya shina, kudhoofika.
diseases.treatment_en: No cure — remove and destroy; resistant varieties where available. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba — ng'oa na uteketeze; tumia aina sugu zilizopo. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Rotation away from brassicas; clean seed.
diseases.scanner_notes: One-sided yellowing is the discriminator vs black rot.

diseases.severity_classes: Patchy (stunted patches) · Severe (galled roots, stand loss)
diseases.symptoms_en: Swollen, distorted galled roots; stunted plants that wilt in heat; favours acid soils.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Mizizi iliyovimba na kupinda; mimea dhaifu inayonyauka jua; hupenda udongo wa tindikali.
diseases.treatment_en: No cure — lime to raise pH above 7 where present; rotate long away from brassicas. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba — weka chokaa kuinua pH juu ya 7; zungusha mashamba mbali na kabichi. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Use clean transplants, avoid moving soil between fields.
diseases.prevention_sw: Tumia miche safi, epuka kuhamisha udongo kati ya mashamba.
diseases.scanner_notes: Photograph washed roots — galls are the diagnosis.

market_notes.sell_windows_en: Two price peaks: dry season (Jan–Mar) and the festive run-up (Nov–Dec). Cabbage does NOT store — sell within 3–4 days of cutting; harvest to order when a buyer exists.
market_notes.sell_windows_sw: Bei hupanda mara mbili: kiangazi (Jan–Mar) na kabla ya sikukuu (Nov–Des). Kabichi haitunzwi — uza ndani ya siku 3–4 baada ya kukata; vuna ukiwa na mnunuzi.
market_notes.price_notes_en: Farm-gate ~15–40 KES per head (November 2026). Plant backwards: mid-Sep transplant harvests into the December window; mid-Oct hits January. Planned acre: 12,000–15,000 heads.
market_notes.price_notes_sw: Bei ya shambani ~15–40 KES kwa kichwa (Novemba 2026). Panga kupanda kinyume: pandikiza katikati ya Septemba uvune Desemba; katikati ya Oktoba uvune Januari. Eka iliyopangwa: vichwa 12,000–15,000.
